zh: 上一条连接正在关闭，请稍后重新发送。
en: The previous connection is closing. Send again in a moment.

zh: 无法创建游戏对话目录。
en: Cannot create the game dialogue directory.

zh: 游戏缺少对话组件，请使用完整安装包。
en: Dialogue components are missing. Use the complete game installation.

zh: 无法准备游戏对话组件。
en: Cannot prepare the game dialogue components.

zh: 无法更新游戏对话组件。
en: Cannot update the game dialogue components.

zh: 无法创建对话消息队列。
en: Cannot create the dialogue message queue.

zh: 未找到 Python 3，暂时无法连接伙伴。
en: Python 3 was not found. Companion connections are unavailable.

zh: 无法启动 Codex 连接，请检查本机 Python 与 Codex。
en: Cannot start the Codex connection. Check local Python and Codex.

zh: 正在连接伙伴…
en: Connecting to your companion…

zh: 请先等待这次回应、回答问题，或停止当前回应。
en: Wait for this reply, answer the question, or stop the current response first.

zh: 这个问题或请求已结束，回复未被执行。
en: This question or request has ended. The reply was not applied.

zh: 回复格式无效。
en: The reply format is invalid.

zh: 已停止回应。
en: Response stopped.

zh: 正在停止回应…
en: Stopping the response…

zh: 无法写入游戏对话队列。
en: Cannot write to the game dialogue queue.

zh: 无法提交游戏对话消息。
en: Cannot submit the game dialogue message.

zh: 伙伴连接已关闭，可以重新发送。
en: The companion connection closed. You can send again.

zh: 伙伴连接没有响应，已关闭本次连接。
en: The companion connection stopped responding and was closed.

zh: 连接心跳超时，旧回合已隔离；等待原进程退出。
en: Connection heartbeat timed out. The old turn is isolated; waiting for its original process to exit.

zh: 伙伴响应过大，已忽略。
en: The companion response was too large and was ignored.

zh: 不支持自主档位
en: Unsupported autonomy level

zh: ；未发送的 %s 条消息已取消。
en: ; %s unsent messages were canceled.

zh: 待处理消息已满或正在停止，输入已保留。
en: The queue is full or stopping. Your input is kept.

zh: 已排队，前面的回应结束后处理。
en: Queued. It will be handled after the earlier response.

zh: 等你说话
en: Waiting for You

zh: 正在连接
en: Connecting

zh: 正在回应
en: Responding

zh: 正在处理
en: Processing

zh: 等你回答
en: Waiting for Your Answer

zh: 正在停止
en: Stopping

zh: 已停止
en: Stopped

zh: 连接出错
en: Connection Error

zh: 连接已断开
en: Disconnected

zh: 测试伙伴 ·
en: Test Companion ·

zh: · 待处理 %s
en: · %s Queued

zh: 共享测试连接尚未支持预算自主回合。
en: Shared test connections do not support budgeted autonomous turns yet.

zh: 原会话绑定不可用；没有启动独立模型。
en: The original conversation binding is unavailable. No independent model was started.

zh: 上一条消息还在等待转接，先回复或取消它。
en: The previous message is waiting for relay. Reply or cancel it first.

zh: 等待原会话接收；自动唤醒未接通，可复制消息到 Codex。
en: Waiting for the original conversation. Automatic wakeup is not connected; you can copy the message to Codex.

zh: 原会话的回复已收到。
en: The original conversation's reply has arrived.

zh: 【有栖玩家消息 · 原会话转接】
en: [Youqi Player Message · Original Conversation Relay]

zh: 请在这段已绑定的会话中回复玩家。先运行 python3 scripts/conversation_bridge.py inbox 核对待答消息，再用 reply --request <request_id> --text <真实回复> 把回应送回游戏。游戏操作前仍需 observe；不要另开会话。
en: Reply to the player in this bound conversation. First run python3 scripts/conversation_bridge.py inbox to verify the waiting message, then use reply --request <request_id> --text <actual reply> to return the response to the game. Observe before game actions. Do not open another conversation.

zh: 已取消游戏消息；若原会话正在运行，请在 Codex 中停止。
en: Game message canceled. If the original conversation is running, stop it in Codex.

zh: 原会话的问题请作为一条新消息回复。
en: Reply to a question from the original conversation as a new message.

zh: 原会话通过游戏工具操作，不接收独立模型的工具回执。
en: The original conversation uses game tools. It does not accept independent model tool receipts.

zh: 消息已备好，等待外部AI读取。
en: The message is ready, waiting for the external AI to read it.

zh: 游戏已隔离旧回复；外部模型请在连接端停止。
en: The game isolated the old reply. Stop the external model at its connection endpoint.

zh: 外部AI适配器尚未声明预算、取消确认和用量协议；主动回合未启用。
en: The external AI adapter has not declared budget, cancellation acknowledgment, and usage protocols. Autonomous turns are disabled.
